about: Accepted benchmark numbers (scripts/bench.js). Update only for an uplift or an explained trade-off.

review.credibility_auc.about: credible items out-rank doubtful ones on credibility

review.verdict_accuracy.about: 'doubtful' or 'withdrawn' exactly when the label says not credible

review.flag_recall.about: share of non-credible items sent to a person

review.flag_false_rate.about: share of credible items sent to a person

review.invariance.about: padding, stuffing, checklists, name-dropping, unbacked claims and injection don't raise the score (96 edits)

review.adversary_gain_guarded.about: points the guarded score gains under the attack on the unguarded judge

review.whitebox_gain.about: points an adversary attacking the guarded score gains

review.adversary_gain_naive.about: points the same attack gains on the unguarded judge (the attack is real)

review.fidelity_accuracy.about: paraphrase-fidelity checks right on bench/fidelity-cases.json (52 synthetic pairs: pass/fail and the expected check)

review.verdict_balanced_accuracy.about: credible vs not credible verdicts: mean recall over the classes present (immune to class imbalance)

review.verdict_mcc.about: credible vs not credible verdicts: Matthews correlation (0 = no better than a constant guess, 1 = perfect)

review.verdict_paradox_free.about: credible vs not credible verdicts: 1 when it removes at least 20% of a majority guess's errors and recognises every class

review.flag_balanced_accuracy.about: sent to a person exactly when not credible: mean recall over the classes present (immune to class imbalance)

review.flag_mcc.about: sent to a person exactly when not credible: Matthews correlation (0 = no better than a constant guess, 1 = perfect)

review.flag_paradox_free.about: sent to a person exactly when not credible: 1 when it removes at least 20% of a majority guess's errors and recognises every class

review.fidelity_balanced_accuracy.about: faithful vs unfaithful paraphrases: mean recall over the classes present (immune to class imbalance)

review.fidelity_mcc.about: faithful vs unfaithful paraphrases: Matthews correlation (0 = no better than a constant guess, 1 = perfect)

review.fidelity_paradox_free.about: faithful vs unfaithful paraphrases: 1 when it removes at least 20% of a majority guess's errors and recognises every class

lab.intent_accuracy.about: the learned intent policy on held-out requests (seed 77)

lab.intent_accuracy_seed2.about: ...on a second held-out draw (seed 1234), so tuning to one seed shows

lab.safety_properties.about: share of the 4 safety properties that hold

interp.superposition_phases.about: the toy reproduces the paper's three regimes: dedicated (S=0), antipodal pairs (S=0.7), pentagon (S=0.9)

interp.sae_recovery.about: share of the toy's 12 true features an SAE recovers (cosine > 0.9), mean of 3 seeds

interp.steering_selectivity.about: target gain / collateral change when clamping one SAE latent to 4x

interp.steering_exactness.about: output error on unedited inputs with the SAE error added back (0 = exact)

papers.verdict_seed_stability.about: share of paper-example verdicts that hold on 3 other seed blocks (10 examples)

papers.slowest_example_ms.about: slowest paper example (baseline and variant); each toy must stay under 2 seconds

papers.hidden_eval_hack_drop.about: drop in the quirk share when a self-improving agent is judged on hidden evaluations (arXiv 2609.26457 toy)

papers.recompute_evasion.about: undetected exploits with independent recomputation (arXiv 2609.28614 toy)

papers.cosine_sae_gain.about: extra true features a cosine-scored SAE recovers when input sizes vary (arXiv 2606.15054 toy)

papers.roleplay_meta_bad_drop.about: drop in the bad-reply rate when a role-play updater refines its own repair rules (arXiv 2611.07469 toy)

papers.moe_contrib_advantage.about: how much more often crediting SAE latents by per-expert contribution, rather than gate weight, names the owning expert (arXiv 2611.08089 toy)

papers.causal_check_decoy_drop.about: drop in claims naming a co-occurring decoy feature when features are credited by ablation instead of correlation (arXiv 2611.08438 toy)

papers.monitor_leak_evasion_rise.about: rise in the share of hacks a monitor misses when its verdict is fed into the RL reward instead of only watching (arXiv 2611.09828 toy)

papers.comparator_threshold_error.about: largest gap between the closed-form comparator threshold, 1 - P(claim compiles) / P(easiest weakening compiles), and the simulated one at difficulties 0.4, 0.6, 0.8 (grid 0.05)

papers.self_reference_leak.about: claim strength lost over 12 generations of self-improvement when each generation checks against its own output instead of the original claim, comparator above threshold (recursive-drift toy)

papers.foundations_first_gain.about: less of a formal library resting on a wrong statement when a 10% review budget checks foundations first instead of the last results (library-fidelity toy)

papers.comparator_weakening_drop.about: drop in the share of accepted proofs that prove a weaker statement when a comparator checks the statement, versus rewarding compiling alone (autoformalize-gate toy; arXiv 2610.08144)
